title: Backup: Playmaker's First Deck (lore build)
summary: The Backup cards are Playmaker's "cybernetic employees" in VRAINS, and they only make sense inside his Cyberse deck. So this list is that deck as he plays it in season 1, against the Knights of Hanoi.

summary.title: Who's in it, and why
points: Backup Secretary, Backup Operator and Backup Supervisor, plus Backup @Ignister (2025), the newest card named Backup. It belongs to Ai's @Ignister line.
His season 1 Cyberse: Cyberse Wizard, Dotscaper, Stack Reviver, ROM Cloudia, Draconnet with Bitron, Linkslayer, Balancer Lord, Backlinker and Cyberse Gadget.
His Spells and Traps: Cynet Universe, Cynet Backdoor, Cynet Mining and Cyberse Beacon.

Extra Deck: Decode Talker, Encode Talker, Link Spider, Honeybot, Security Dragon, Talkback Lancer, Link Disciple and Link Devotee, ending in Firewall Dragon, Accesscode Talker and Firewall Dragon Darkfluid.

summary.title: Starters & Swarm
points: Backup Secretary summons itself from hand while you control any Cyberse monster, providing immediate Link material.
Backup Operator targets a face-up monster you control that a Link Monster points to, returning it to hand to Special Summon Operator from hand.
Backup @Ignister Special Summons itself next to an Extra Deck Cyberse and searches a DARK Cyberse monster from the Deck.
Draconnet summons Level 2 Normal Monster Bitron directly from the Deck on Normal Summon, enabling Link Spider or Link-2 climbs.
Cyberse Gadget revives a Level 2 or lower monster from the GY upon Normal Summon and spawns a Gadget Token when sent to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Cyberse Gadget + Backup Secretary
steps: Normal Summon Cyberse Gadget and activate Backup Secretary's effect in hand to Special Summon itself to the field.
Link Summon Backup Supervisor using Cyberse Gadget and Backup Secretary.
Cyberse Gadget triggers in the GY to Special Summon a Level 2 Cyberse Gadget Token.
Link Summon Link Spider using the Cyberse Gadget Token.
Use Backup Supervisor and Link Spider to Link Summon Decode Talker in the Extra Monster Zone.
When Backup Supervisor leaves the field, activate its effect to Special Summon Backup Secretary back from your GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Link Climb
points: Firewall Dragon is Playmaker's ace: returns monsters from field or GY to hand up to the number of co-linked monsters, and summons a Cyberse from hand when a linked monster is destroyed or sent to GY.
Decode Talker gains 500 ATK for each monster it points to and tributes a pointed monster to negate an opponent's targeting effect.
Encode Talker shields a linked monster from battle damage and grants the battle damage as bonus ATK to another linked monster.
Accesscode Talker gains massive ATK based on its Link material and banishes Link Monsters from GY to destroy opponent's cards without allowing responses.
Firewall Dragon Darkfluid accumulates counters based on Cyberse card types in GY and detaches counters to negate monster effects.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Cynet Mining discards 1 card to search any Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster from your Deck.
Cynet Backdoor banishes a Cyberse monster you control to search a weaker Cyberse, returning the banished monster to attack directly.
Cynet Universe boosts all Link Monsters by 300 ATK and recycles a monster from the GY into the Deck when sent to the GY.
Cyberse Beacon searches a Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster when you take battle or effect damage.
